name: Martial Ka'tah
text: At the start of each Fight phase, choose a stance for your army that lasts until the phase ends. Dacatarai: melee weapons carried by models in units with this ability gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Rendax: those melee weapons gain [LETHAL HITS].

name: Praesidium Shield
text: A model carrying a praesidium shield has 1 additional Wound (already included in the model's Wounds).

name: Stand Vigil
text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, you may re-roll a wound roll of 1. If the unit is within range of an objective marker you control, you may re-roll the wound roll instead.

name: Stand Vigil (held objective)
text: While the unit is within range of an objective marker you control, its attacks may re-roll the wound roll.

name: Purity of Execution
text: Ranged attacks made by models in this unit that target a PSYKER unit have [PRECISION] and [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

name: Purity of Execution (Devastating Wounds)
text: Ranged attacks made by models in this unit that target a PSYKER unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

name: Deft Parry
text: Each time a melee attack targets this unit, subtract 1 from the hit roll.
